name: Opacity-to-Color Translation GAN
definition: A GAN that produces a 256x256 color image conditioned on viewpoint, color TF, opacity TF (latent representation), and the 64x64 opacity image.
summary: The Opacity-to-Color Translation GAN synthesizes high-resolution volume-rendered color images from low-resolution opacity inputs by explicitly conditioning on color transfer functions, distinguishing it from opacity-only models.
